settings.title: Kids Chores
page.title: Kids Chores
page.progressHint: Fill the sun by earning points today
page.defaultCongrats: All done for today — great work!
page.emptyBody: An administrator can add chores and pick the weekdays under Settings → Modules → Kids Chores.
settings.householdHint: Chores reset after midnight in the timezone below. Completed items leave the overview until then.
settings.displayTitleHint: Shown as the overview widget name (for example a child’s name)
settings.pointGoalMax: Max points from chores on one day: {{max}}
settings.pointGoalMaxNone: No active chores yet — the max updates when you add chores.
settings.congrats: Congratulation message when every chore is done
settings.webhookHint: Paste the full URL (https://…). Leave blank and save to remove it. Test Yes/No sends {"state":"yes","done":true} or {"state":"no","done":false}.
settings.notifyAdmin: Record in points history when the goal is reached
settings.showOnWallHint: When chores are scheduled for today, list them on the household wall display.
settings.sequentialUnlockHint: Only the next chore is shown until the ones above it are done. Drag the list to set the order.
settings.testWebhookYesTitle: Sends POST {"state":"yes","done":true} to the reward webhook
settings.testWebhookNoTitle: Sends POST {"state":"no","done":false} to the reward webhook
settings.resetTodayHint: Mark all of today’s chores as not done again, and send the reward webhook with earned: 0
settings.resetTodayConfirm: Reset today’s chores so they show as not done again? The reward webhook will receive earned: 0.
settings.noChoresYet: No chores yet. Add the first one below.
settings.choreWebhookPlaceholder: e.g. notify when done (walking the dog, arrives home)
settings.choreWebhookHint: Optional. On complete, this URL is asked first. A positive reply (e.g. {"ok":true} / {"state":"yes"} / HTTP 200) finishes the chore. A negative reply ({"ok":false}, {"state":"no"}, negative number, HTTP 4xx/5xx) blocks redemption.
settings.choreResetWebhookHint: Optional. Sent as {"state":"no","done":false} when Reset today clears the chore.
reason.day: That chore is not scheduled today.
reason.webhook: Webhook is not configured or did not answer.
reason.webhook_denied: The receiving system did not approve this chore.
reason.locked: Finish the chores above this one first.
